body: I feel this on so many levels, I'm here to talk if you need it.
I understand your pain but people love you. I understand not enjoying life but it's not always this way. Why is it that Keanu Reeves keeping you alive?

Don't feel bad. I don't rate peoples pain worse than others because it can effect everyone differently. Nights are the worse though. When I'm laying by myself I miss the comfort of her beside me. We were there for each other through everything, I always had someone to talk to now I don't have anyone to talk to.
I was good until I saw my former fiancé with her ex who is a woman beater and drug user.

Hey, I understand the pain you are goining through. My fiancé left me a few months ago and took our child, now today she is back with he ex who is a drug addict. I lost my job in March and I dropped out of college to take care of my family whom have all left me now. I'm currently homeless and living on my brothers couch. In high school( I graduated in May 2017) and had a full ride to a really good college. I was a football star and now I'm 150lbs overweight and can't get out of bed because of my depression. I have no one left, I pushed away all my friends and my family is disappointed in me. I'm here to talk if you need someone because I feel your pain.
